description: This file defines the SkillSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and encapsulates search filter parameters for skills, including fields for 'name' and 'description', along with allowed sorting options.

classes.name: SkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for specifying search filters for skills, including sortable fields, name, and description parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'description' filter parameter.
